data_note: All examples use illustrative sample data.

examples.name: line
examples.description: Monthly sample revenue in USD, with a missing March observation.

examples.name: area
examples.description: Sample monthly revenue shown as an area with a zero baseline.

examples.name: stacked_area
examples.description: Sample online and store revenue, stacked by month in USD.

examples.name: step_line
examples.description: Sample capacity changes taking effect at the end of each interval.

examples.name: time_line
examples.description: Sample request counts at irregular UTC dates with an x-axis zoom slider.

examples.name: bar
examples.description: Sample monthly revenue compared with vertical bars in USD.

examples.name: horizontal_bar
examples.description: Sample product revenue ranked from top to bottom in USD.

examples.name: grouped_bar
examples.description: Sample monthly revenue and cost compared with grouped bars in USD.

examples.name: stacked_bar
examples.description: Sample online and store revenue stacked into monthly totals in USD.

examples.name: histogram
examples.description: Precomputed sample duration-bin counts. The last bin includes its right edge.

examples.name: waterfall
examples.description: Sample waterfall: opening 100 USD, revenue plus 60, cost minus 30, closing 130. All cumulative balances stay nonnegative.

examples.name: pie
examples.description: Sample nonnegative parts of a whole: A 40, B 35, C 25.

examples.name: donut
examples.description: Sample category shares using a donut configuration of a pie series.

examples.name: rose
examples.description: Sample category magnitudes using a radius-based rose pie configuration.

examples.name: scatter
examples.description: Sample account spend versus revenue, both measured in USD.

examples.name: bubble
examples.description: Sample account spend and revenue; bubble area is proportional to order count, with precomputed diameters.

examples.name: effect_scatter
examples.description: Sample spend versus revenue points, with ripple emphasis on hover.

examples.name: radar
examples.description: Sample product profiles with speed, quality, and support scored on the same 0–100 scale.

examples.name: tree
examples.description: Sample organization hierarchy with engineering and operations branches.

examples.name: treemap
examples.description: Sample product sales hierarchy with leaf values and parent totals derived from children.

examples.name: sunburst
examples.description: Sample product sales hierarchy expressed as nested radial segments.

examples.name: boxplot
examples.description: Precomputed sample whiskers and quartiles for three teams, with two separate outliers.

examples.name: candlestick
examples.description: Sample prices in USD using open, close, low, high order and equal trading-session spacing.

examples.name: heatmap
examples.description: Sample request counts by weekday and time period; color maps the third dimension.

examples.name: calendar_heatmap
examples.description: Sample activity on five October dates; unobserved dates are not assigned zero.

examples.name: parallel
examples.description: Sample product rows across speed, cost in USD, and quality dimensions.

examples.name: lines
examples.description: Sample directed routes on value axes. The Cartesian coordinate system is set explicitly.

examples.name: graph
examples.description: Sample directed service network with stable node IDs and force layout.

examples.name: sankey
examples.description: Sample acyclic energy flows: supply 100 units split into industry 60, homes 30, and losses 10.

examples.name: funnel
examples.description: Sample conversion-stage counts in process order, with a 0–1000 count domain.

examples.name: gauge
examples.description: Sample completion of 72 percent points on a 0–100 gauge.

examples.name: pictorial_bar
examples.description: Sample category magnitudes rendered with repeated clipped rectangles on a 0–100 scale.

examples.name: theme_river
examples.description: Sample online and store values at matching dates using a floating streamgraph baseline.

examples.name: chord
examples.description: Sample weighted relationships between A, B, and C, including a cycle. Requires core ECharts 6.

examples.name: mixed_bar_line
examples.description: Sample monthly revenue and conversion with explicit USD and percent y-axes.

examples.name: dataset_bar
examples.description: Sample shared record dataset with named dimensions and explicit revenue/cost encode mappings.

examples.name: polar_bar
examples.description: Sample values for four categories with angle categories and a 0–100 radius axis.

examples.name: map
examples.description: Toy regional choropleth; requires external registration of the synthetic sample-regions GeoJSON.
requires: Register examples/assets/sample-regions.geojson as sample-regions before setting the option.

examples.name: custom_bar_range
examples.description: Sample range bars for an externally registered barRange custom renderer. Not supported by native Streamlit.
requires: ECharts 6 plus @echarts-x/custom-bar-range, with its barRange renderer registered.

examples.name: bar3d
examples.description: Sample category/category/value bars in a prepared ECharts GL host.
requires: ECharts GL loaded and compatible with the exact ECharts version.

examples.name: wordcloud
examples.description: Sample weighted words in a host with echarts-wordcloud loaded.
requires: echarts-wordcloud registered in the runtime; check version compatibility.

examples.name: liquid_fill
examples.description: Sample liquid-fill fraction of 0.65, labeled with its precomputed 65% value.
requires: echarts-liquidfill registered in the runtime; check version compatibility.
